name: Covenant of Frost and Snow
desc: A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.

desc.text:
"The law shall uphold all the land under my jurisdiction, and thus shall it be blessed with peace."
"These laws shall sanction all who commit acts of terror and disrupt order."
"We shall conquer humanity's weaknesses and bring peace to these long borders."
"We shall forsake useless emotions and keep our frozen hearts beating."
One who wishes to lead the Transportation Bureau and maintain law and order within Snezhnaya must heed the admonitions of centuries past,
And lend one's ear to the tale of the leader who ultimately forsook emotion and kindness, pointing a bow at those they once called friends.
It was a contest between order and chaos, a battle between defense and destruction, and after that, a showdown between old friends.
In those days, the young human was not the head of the Transport Bureau, and the pale fae served not yet at the Burner of Cities' side.
Both lamented the world's injustice and mourned its futile struggles, and because they shared ideals and evenly matched strength,
They found kindred spirits in each other — an enviable thing in a time when humans and fae could not see eye to eye in the least.
"Chaos can breed hope, and new buildings can be fashioned atop ruins. Destruction is not utterly without cause, but is meant to bring about golden rebirth."
"Yet brutality has left this nation wounded and scarred. Those who live within its bounds need a new order and new laws."
Thus, the two diverged over the moral path this land should take. Human and fae, in the end, should struggle to share the same ideals.
And though they had parted ways with no desire to meet again, the justice of order cannot by its nature coexist with the brutality of destruction.
The clash, therefore, was a foregone conclusion. The human led the Chicota, becoming the guardian of law and order, standing guard amidst snow and frost,
While the fae became "the wise one," using the name of old royalty to incite the masses who longed for destruction, all in the name of rebirth.
This went on till white dew had condensed into frost, and that frost had turned into dew, the metal bells ringing thrice, then thrice again.
As the train passed the white birches, and both sharp sword and bright pearl fell, the long and drawn-out conflict would finally come to an end.
The fae fled, covered by brigands, but could not deceive the chief of the Chicota.
The bow was raised, the arrow nocked, and he locked onto his target without pause, until the fae, as if realizing something, turned and looked upon him.
The human could not help but ask himself: When had this ever-beating heart grown as frigid as the frost and snow?
But he could still see the guiding one's fall as if it were still before his eyes. He knew all too well how dangerous his friend of old was.
The words that had come along with the bow rang in his ears still: "This bow is not given unto Eprokin, but rather to the guardian of order."
One ought to harbor sorrow and compassion as a person, but the leader of the Chicota must judge in accordance with the law that governs all living beings.
Many humans in years past would dedicate their lives to the moving trains, consigning themselves to the endless blizzards.
And the promise he made when he received the bow and arrows became the oath that generation after generation of Chicota heads would swear upon taking the seat.
"We shall conquer humanity's weaknesses and bring peace to these long borders."
"We shall forsake useless emotions and keep our frozen hearts beating."
"Let me exercise humility in my authority, and keep my conscience as I fulfill my duty."
"Let cowardice and arrogance be far from me, that I may never betray this oath."

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Borderland Bow Billet
customize.desc:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star bows.

In terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: White Iron Chunk
customize.desc: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

customize.name: Diagram: Covenant of Frost and Snow
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Covenant of Frost and Snow (Bow).

customize.name: Emberwell
customize.desc: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

customize.name: Blade of Atonement
customize.desc: A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.

customize.name: Song of the Vigil
customize.desc: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

customize.name: Echoes of the Heart
customize.desc: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Rise of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In the east of the tundra, that arrogant monster born within the wing-like mountain is nothing more than a lowly peddler of malt and minerals.
The Vila under his command are but weaklings with insect wings, while the Domovoy cannot even lift weapons with their stunted arms.
Who would heed the clamor of such rabble? What strength could they possibly have to stand against the onslaught of the kings of Volkodlak?

materials.name: Hollow Root of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
With only a few crystals grown upon it, this branch holds little power and gives off a faint glow.

materials.name: Chimeric Core
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
This is the most fundamental core grown within a man-made monster. Yet, simple as it may be, it contains the primordial design for the growth of all man-made creations.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Muster of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"They seized the canyon by sheer luck. That laughably arrogant fool is no more than a spent bolt, a fading gale."
"Even with all their strength, they can barely hold back a fraction of our forces. Soon enough, their defeat will be plain to see."
"Soldiers, march onward! For our king has already foretold, for this entire campaign shall end in effortless victory!"

A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch bearing a fair number of crystals. It feels heavy in the hand, and traces of vitality can still be felt within it even after it has broken away from the Leshy's body.

materials.name: Symbiotic Chimeric Nucleus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
A relatively complex core harvested from a man-made monster. This symbiotic nucleus is engineered to sustain the biological cycles of two distinct life-forms, seamlessly weaving them into a single organism.

materials.name: Clarion of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"Our enemy Monomakh has built his palace beyond the valley, a sign that he is fully confident in his ability to contend with us."
"As matters stand, he deserves our utmost caution. Any talk of a swift victory should now be set aside."
"But it matters not. With wisdom to guide us all, the King shall stand with the clans to overcome every hardship and usher in a glorious new era!"

materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch with a fully formed crystal core. It contains vitality that will not easily fade. If buried in the soil, it would likely grow into a new Leshy before long.

materials.name: Prime Chimeric Nexus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
The most complex core a man-made monster can possibly sustain, serving as an artificially engineered yet flawless seed of life. Whoever brought this creation into life has surely unlocked the very secrets of how life itself is shaped.

materials.name: Triumph of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"All hail the Tsar, Protector of all fae, Heir to the Pale Star, sovereign born of sacred blood!"
"Praise be, for the entire tundra now stands as one beneath the brilliance of the Polestar!"
"Praise be, for His Majesty has slain the false king and embraced all fae. Such is his benevolence, such is his mercy!"
